tools.name: runvouch_status
tools.description: Health of all watched agents: state (ok/alert/failed/unproven/running/waiting), last run, 24h cost, open alerts.

tools.name: runvouch_alerts
tools.description: Open (un-acknowledged) alerts: MISSED, FAILED, NO_EVIDENCE, BUDGET_RUN, BUDGET_DAY, RETRY_STORM, DRIFT, STALLED.

tools.name: runvouch_run_start
tools.description: Report that a run of `agent` started. Returns run_id.

tools.name: runvouch_run_end
tools.description: Report that a run ended, with status and evidence dict (name -> bool or {type:'url',url}). Green run without evidence alerts.

tools.name: runvouch_run_proof
tools.description: Tamper-evident proof of a finished run: hashed record, Merkle path, day root, chain hash and OpenTimestamps status. Verify offline with templates/verify_proof.py.
